scientificClaim: Starting from the coordinate-bearing 5OVE/AXE hit, the public Molarium Chemist Actions workflow explored three Phe890 rotamer basins after compound-21 growth created a clash, selected the Phe890 chi1/chi2 = -180°/90° branch by the registered coupled side-chain/pose criterion, and propagated that predicted receptor state to BAY-293.

scientificBoundary.phe890: Predicted by public rotamer enumeration, receptor-reference update, pose refinement, parameterization, and induced-fit optimization actions.
scientificBoundary.tyr884: Not predicted in this run; the Tyr884 difference is a historical comparison between deposited structures and is not part of either replay script.

fullExploration.meaning: Complete execution trace, including inspections, all three explored Phe890 branches, undo operations, and final selected-branch replay.

selectedRoute.meaning: Fail-closed operational replay of the already-selected route. It pins the v3 pose-seeding protocol, persistent Phe890 identity, the unique normalized chi-angle branch, and feasible pose applications. Same-execution coordinate hashes still guard enumeration and application, but post-WebGPU coordinate bytes are not treated as a portable cross-adapter identity. It omits discarded branches and read-only freeze inspections, so it is not the evidence that branch search occurred.
